newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hongkong Land unit sets HK$3.6 bln loan.
newsitem.headline: Hongkong Land unit sets HK$3.6 bln loan.

text.p: The Hongkong Land Property Co Ltd, a unit of Hongkong Land Holdings Ltd, has mandated three banks to arrange a HK$3.6 billion revolving credit/term loan facility, bankers said on Friday.
Chase Manhattan Asia, HSBC Investment Bank Asia and Societe Generale Asia are the mandated arrangers and they are seeking underwriters to join the deal.
Bankers said the deal is divided into two tranches.

Tranche A of HK$1.8 billion has a maturity of five years. It pays a margin of 42 basis points over the Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate and, with fees, an all-in return to underwriters of 50 basis points.
Tranche B of HK$1.8 billion has a maturity of seven years. It pays a margin of 50 basis points over HIBOR and, with fees, an all-in return to underwriters of 56.4 basis points.
Both tranches are revolving credits for the first two years and convert to term loans thereafter.
Proceeds of the facility will be used for refinancing existing debts and for general working capital.
